WORKING NOTES

- Keep the wet path and hedge for an outdoor autumn setting.
Try this: Keep the wet path and hedge for an autumn setting.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair walks along a wet stone path beside a low
hedge. She wears a sheer amber floral blouse with
flared sleeves, a tie front, and a white cami
underneath. A silver conchos belt cinches her
waist. Light-wash flared jeans complete the look.
Her expression is calm, with her gaze to the side.
Soft autumn daylight, a palette of amber, rust, and
pale denim. Earthy and relaxed, in the style of an
autumn street-style editorial.
